proposed_scopes.scope_justification: The primary CWS outcome and treatment-by-time interaction support the requested overall cannabis withdrawal severity outcome. Treatment was 6 days; primary model included all study days 1–9, while published abstinence means exclude baseline and cover days 2–6. Thus this is a close but not exact match to the target's medication-period contrast.
proposed_scopes.population_justification: Methods state intention-to-treat analysis included all 51 randomized participants. Actual outcome observations varied due to early discharge/dropout and missing CWS questionnaires imputed across five datasets; the reported model is not simply complete-case all-randomized observed data.
unknowns: No numerical between-group difference on the CWS scale or confidence interval is reported in the captured passage; interaction F statistic is omnibus across time.
